venue.name: [Baku Engineering University](http://www.beu.edu.az/)
venue.address: Xırdalan şəh, Həsən Əliyev küç, 120 AZ0101, Abşeron, Baku, Azerbaijan

items.information: Welcome once again to Baku – largest city in Caucasus, beautifully situated by the eagle-like east part of Azerbaijan! Eagle of the East 2018 is a friendly and relaxed cube competition open to all who wish to participate. It is currently one of the largest competitions in South Caucasus and we are hoping for many participants also this year.

items.name: Bulgarian Open 2018
items.information:
First WCA competition in Bulgaria. Maximum 1 guest per competitor. Registration fee to be paid in the venue on the day of the competition.

The address of the Technical university of Sofia is 8 Kliment Ohridski boulevard, but the entrance of the venue is on Rosario street.

Първо състезание на WCA в България. Позволени са максимум 1 гост за състезател (лимит на стаята).
Адресът на Технически университет - гр. София е бул. "Климент Охридски" 8, но входът към блок 3 е откъм ул. Росарио.

Two weeks before the competition, registered competitors will be requested by email to confirm their participation. Registered competitors must reply at least three days before the competition, otherwise they may be removed from the competitor list.

items.information:
The limitation is 100 participants, based on a first-come-first-serve rule.
For Chinese domestic participants, a completed registration is online registration plus prepaid registration fee. For oversea participants, if you can't pay the fee online via Alipay, pls contact the delegate. Then we will make a reservation for you by manually accepting your registration and you can pay the fee by cash at the venue. Please check the competition website for registration and the other information.

items.name: Frankfurt Cube Days 2018

venue.name: Gemeindehaus Thomasgemeinde
venue.address: Heddernheimer Kirchstraße 5, 60439 Frankfurt am Main, Germany

items.information: The entrance fee is 5 Euro per competitor and day (= 10 Euro for both days) and has to be payed at the venue on the first day that you registered for. If you are not able to come, please let us know until January 31st, which is also the last opportunity to cancel your registration at no costs. If you don't show up without canceling, you will be charged the full entrance fee. Entrance fee for guests is 5 Euro (ticket will be valid on both days). Please have a look at the competition website for more details.

items.name: Incredible Pencil Mania 2018
items.information:
Registration Fee:

Any requested changes to registration before the deadline will be honored. Your registration is not complete until your name shows up on the list. If you believe you paid and your name isn't showing up, please contact us and we will work it out.

If you have registered and are no longer able to attend, please contact us. If it is before February 3rd, you are eligible for a refund for half of your fee on the condition that there is someone on the waitlist willing to take your spot. Attempting to file a chargeback for the registration fee will lead to being blacklisted from future WCA events.

The registration fee will be $40 per competitor and there is a competitor limit of 350. Registration will open on Thursday September 7th at 8pm EST and will close on February 3rd, 2017 or when the competitor limit is reached. Competitors MUST register and pay online in order to compete. No at-the-door registrations or payments will be accepted. ALL SPECTATORS ARE WELCOME TO ATTEND FOR FREE.

Please read the "Competitor Information" tab before registering.
